faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Sphera and Sphera Live.
faq.a1: Sphera is an intelligent AI-powered study assistant. It analyzes your courses and lecture materials to automatically generate structured revision sheets, interactive quizzes, and flashcards—all designed to maximize retention.
faq.q2: What is Sphera Live and how does it work?
faq.a2: Sphera Live is our real-time multiplayer mode. A host creates or generates a quiz (from a PDF, CampusSphere link, or manually), then launches a lobby. Participants enter the 6-letter PIN on their mobile or computer to compete live with synchronized timers, live leaderboards, and podium celebrations.
faq.q3: Do I need an account to use Sphera and Sphera Live?
faq.a3: Yes, an account is required to access Sphera. If you are already registered on CampusSphere, your account is seamlessly synchronized with 1-click SSO (no re-registration needed). Both hosts and players log in with their account to create sessions, join live games, and save their history.
faq.q4: How does revision sheet and quiz generation work?
faq.a4: Simply upload your document (PDF, DOCX, TXT) or paste a CampusSphere link. Sphera analyzes it, extracts key concepts, formats definitions, and provides you with a crystal-clear study sheet, a targeted quiz, and flashcards ready to memorize.
faq.q5: Can I share my study sessions?
faq.a5: Yes, absolutely! Sphera allows you to create revision workspaces with all necessary tools. You can also generate a public link to share a specific study session with your classmates.
faq.a6: Sphera offers full free access to get started and test all tools, including Sphera Live. Advanced premium plans will be available for students seeking unlimited quotas and in-depth analytics.
faq.a7: Your data privacy and security are our top priorities. Your documents are encrypted and only used to generate your personal study materials. They are never sold or shared with third parties.
faq.q8: Does Sphera work for all majors?
faq.a8: Yes! Sphera's AI adapts to all fields of study: law, medicine, engineering, economics, humanities, or prep schools. It understands specialized technical vocabulary for each subject.
